findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded for controller requests
findings.body: `ensure_loaded!` is invoked only from the controller filter, but the translation accelerator loads only `config.locale` when `I18n.t` is called. The fallback backend probes fallback locales directly through the backend, so it does not re-enter the accelerator to load the site-default or English YAML files. As a result, translations performed outside an HTTP controller request (notably Sidekiq jobs, mailers, rake tasks, and startup code) will report a missing translation instead of falling back when the fallback locale has not already happened to be loaded in that process. Load the entire `I18n.fallbacks[config.locale]` chain in the translation/loading path, or otherwise make fallback loading global rather than controller-specific.
